title: What our students have gone out and won
description: Recorded from the school archive and from the regional press. Achievements are added each session by the school office.

items.title: State-level representation in throwball
items.description: High school students represented the school at a state-level throwball fixture, one of the strongest results on our sporting record.

items.title: Medals in patriotic singing competition
items.description: Students who entered the inter-school patriotic singing competition returned with medals and participation certificates.

items.title: Junior college results featured in the regional press
items.description: The achievement of students at Dr. Bower Apostolic Junior College was carried as a news feature by UCN News Live, Nagpur.

items.title: Carrom — high school championship performance
items.description: High school students competed in carrom fixtures at the district championship venue, an event the school enters every session.

items.title: Science & tour exhibition
items.description: Students designed, built and presented working models and study-tour findings to parents and visiting schools at the annual exhibition.

items.title: Robotics workshop programme
items.description: High school classes completed a practical robotics programme covering sensing, control and simple autonomous behaviour.

items.title: Apostolic Sports 2025 streamed in full
items.description: The annual sports meet was broadcast live from the school ground so that families unable to attend could watch every event.

items.title: Plantation drive
items.description: Students across sections planted and took responsibility for saplings on and around the campus as part of the school's environmental programme.
